summary: The new mathematics is genuinely new, but the PR adds a private curvature-vanishing transport lemma that is the unexported curvature sibling of existing public isometry API, and writes the open-inclusion local-isometry argument twice instead of reusing `mfderiv_inclusion_apply`.
